exposure: absence of a close person during labor due to nationwide ban on visitors to maternity wards
outcome: use of local or systemic analgesia
length of the first stage of labor
length of the second stage of labor
cohort: 4805 births during the study period in 2019 and 4514 births in 2020 in the Czech Republic
finding: The absence of a close person during labor due to a visitor ban during the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic did not significantly impact perinatal outcomes or maternal injuries in the Czech Republic.
